description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing User Generated Documents (UGDs) or Templates in the Apache Fineract project. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and merging templates, with detailed annotations for API documentation and security.

classes.name: TemplatesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing User Generated Documents (Templates) in Apache Fineract, including CRUD operations and template merging.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all UGDs, optionally filtered by type and entity.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a template data structure for UI maintenance screens.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new UGD based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific UGD by ID.

methods.name: getTemplateByTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the template data for a specific UGD.

methods.name: saveTemplate
methods.description: Updates an existing UGD with new data.

methods.name: deleteTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a specific UGD by ID.

methods.name: mergeTemplate
methods.description: Merges data into a template and returns the generated document (HTML).
